verdict.text: The data partly support the claim. For the central Sahel, wet season (June to September), 2001 to 2025, the regional average increased by 0.207 mm/day per decade (p = 0.030, significant at the 0.05 level), but only 15% of the mapped area is flagged in the claimed direction after false-discovery control. This describes the data over this period; it does not say why it changed or what comes next.

finding.verdict_text: The data partly support the claim. For the central Sahel, wet season (June to September), 2001 to 2025, the regional average increased by 0.207 mm/day per decade (p = 0.030, significant at the 0.05 level), but only 15% of the mapped area is flagged in the claimed direction after false-discovery control. This describes the data over this period; it does not say why it changed or what comes next.
not_supported: It does not say why the value changed, and it does not predict what happens next.
It describes this region, season and period only; it does not apply to other regions, seasons or periods.
It does not test whether the pattern of cells as a whole is unlikely by chance (field significance was not tested).
False-discovery control does not validate any single hotspot and does not measure the share of area that is wrong.
finding.selection_disclosure: The question, region, season and period were registered before any data were downloaded (WP0 claim registration) and were not changed after looking at results. The regional test that decides the verdict was chosen by a rule declared in advance (method addendum 2), applied to simulated data only and before any claim result was seen: the candidate that kept its false-positive rate at this series' persistence, with the highest power. Raw Mann-Kendall and the originally registered Hamed-Rao version are shown as context. The method addenda and one later correction to the cell rule are in the stats log.
finding.scope_text: The change per decade is for the area-weighted average of the whole region (the containing area), not for any hotspot or single cell. The map shows where individual cells pass the tests; any hotspot value is pointwise and is not adjusted for having been selected.

method_notes: Python is the source of truth; the browser replays these numbers.
Anomalies are computed per cell against its own per-calendar-month climatology over the claim period before any averaging.
Regional series: cos(latitude) weighted mean of anomalies; a region-month needs the coverage threshold of valid cells; a season needs at least two thirds of its months.

Mann-Kendall S and tie-corrected Var(S); Hamed-Rao (1998) correction from Sen-detrended rank autocorrelations with significance-screened lags, factor floored at 1. The correction is less reliable for short series.

Missing years: Mann-Kendall and Sen use valid years only (Sen uses calendar-year differences); Hamed-Rao counts lags in valid-observation order, which treats observations after a gap as adjacent (approximation).
Slope interval and chart band: residual moving-block bootstrap around the Sen line; same draws for both; raw trending values are never resampled.

Benjamini-Hochberg controls the expected share of false discoveries among flagged cells under independence or positive dependence (Benjamini and Yekutieli 2001); spatial correlation alone does not establish that; the rate was measured on correlated synthetic fields. It does not control the share of area that is wrong and does not validate any single hotspot. Flagged-area fractions are descriptive.
Field significance is out of scope. Hotspot-mean intervals, if shown, are pointwise and not adjusted for selection.
Synthetic calibration does not establish that BH is valid for every real field.

cells.cells_mode_note: bh_flags: rung-4 flags are false-discovery controlled (measured on correlated synthetic fields). unadjusted_descriptive: rung-3 flags are UNADJUSTED and descriptive; no false-discovery claim; the verdict does not use the map. off: validation not attached.

rungs.name: Raw Mann-Kendall
rungs.what_changes: raw seasonal means, assuming independent years
rungs.threshold_text: flag when the cell's own two-sided p is below 0.05
rungs.share_note: cell_share = flagged cells / tested cells; area_share = cos(latitude)-weighted share of the tested area; they differ

rungs.name: Seasonal anomalies
rungs.what_changes: anomalies against each cell's own same-month climatology
rungs.threshold_text: flag when the cell's own two-sided p is below 0.05
rungs.share_note: cell_share = flagged cells / tested cells; area_share = cos(latitude)-weighted share of the tested area; they differ

rungs.name: Autocorrelation correction
rungs.what_changes: Mann-Kendall with Hamed-Rao correction (all lags up to n/3)
rungs.threshold_text: flag when the cell's own two-sided p is below 0.05
rungs.share_note: cell_share = flagged cells / tested cells; area_share = cos(latitude)-weighted share of the tested area; they differ

rungs.name: False-discovery control
rungs.what_changes: Benjamini-Hochberg at q = 0.1, declared before results
rungs.threshold_text: flag when the Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted p is at most q = 0.1 (for this map that is a raw p of about 0.014 or less)
rungs.explain: Rungs 1 to 3 flag a cell when its own p-value is below 0.05, which limits the chance of a false flag in each cell taken alone. Rung 4 asks a different question: it keeps the expected share of false flags among all flagged cells at or below q = 0.10 (Benjamini-Hochberg). The two rules use different cut-offs and answer different questions, so rung 4 can flag more cells than rung 3. That is not a bug, and neither percentage is the chance that a flagged cell is really changing.
rungs.share_note: cell_share = flagged cells / tested cells; area_share = cos(latitude)-weighted share of the tested area; they differ

cells.rung2_note: With complete months, anomalies only shift each cell's series by a constant, which Mann-Kendall and Sen ignore; rung 2 changes a cell only where months are missing.
cells.flagged_in_direction_def: flag at the rung AND the cell's Sen slope has the claimed sign
cells.area_weights: cos(latitude); fractions are of valid cells' weight; descriptive, never an error rate
